references.text: Korah's sons did not die, which shows that Korah's descendants survived and continued as a clan in Israel.
Korah, who was the father of Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph, led a rebellion against Moses and Aaron.
The lineage of Korah through Abiasaph and Korah is mentioned in connection with the service of the Levites.
The singer Heman was a descendant of Korah through Assir and Abiasaph.
The Korahites served as gatekeepers at the tabernacle, a duty passed down from their ancestors.
Several psalms are attributed to the sons of Korah, showing that their descendants became prominent singers in the temple.
One of the psalms attributed to the sons of Korah, the descendants of those mentioned in this verse.
The sons of Korah composed this psalm, demonstrating their role in the music of the temple.
Confirmation of the lineage of the Korahites through a parallel list of ancestors Assir and Elkanah.
A parallel genealogy confirming the names of Korah's sons and descendants in a different order.
A direct parallel confirming the family line of Korah's sons: Assir, Elkanah, and Ebiasaph.
Confirms the existence of 'the clan of the Korahites' as a distinct group within the tribe of Levi.
